blocks.text: Zsa Zsa Padilla is overwhelmed with grief as she announced the passing of her brother Sonny, who died at the age of 57 last Sept. 13. The veteran singer-actress shared the obituary through her Instagram page on Tuesday, Sept. 15. The cause of death was not immediately disclosed to the public. “It is with deep sadness that we announce the passing of our dearest brother, Peregrine ‘Sonny’ Padilla,” she said. “Sonny was deeply loved, and his passing leaves an immeasurable void in our family.
